dashboards.name: Market Statistics
dashboards.description: Price, Volatility, Spread, Volume, Trade Size and Quote Size for one APAC market over a date range - per 10 minute bucket or per date, in shares or USD notional. Market wide: the universe is every name on the feed carrying the country suffix, not an index. Source of truth is market_stats_kmonitor.q; regenerate this file with build_dashboard.py rather than editing it.

parameters.name: country
parameters.label: Market
parameters.help: Add more suffixes to .ms.mkt in the queries file first.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.label: Volume unit
parameters.help: Changes what Volume, Trade Size and Quote Size mean. Price, Volatility and Spread are always bps.

parameters.name: view
parameters.label: View
parameters.help: intraday is one bar per 10 minutes; daily is one bar per date, computed over the whole day rather than averaged from the buckets.

datasets.name: fx
datasets.raw_qsql:
/ fxlast per name, for the notional unit.  Empty and unused for shares - the
/ query still runs, it just returns nothing to join.
{[ctry]
  sfx:"*.",string ctry;
  select fxlast:last fxlast by date,sym from target_stock
    where {{#historical}}date within ({{date_from}};{{date_to}}){{/historical}}{{#realtime}}date=.z.D{{/realtime}},
      sym like sfx, fxlast>0
 }[{{param:country}}]
